name: Hexworth C2 Device Firmware (XIAO ESP32-S3)
description: Hexworth's reference C2-backed device, compiled for the Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 (dual-core Xtensa, 8MB flash, USB-OTG). Same WiFi captive-portal provisioning, optional pairing-code registration, and ping/echo/blink/reboot capabilities as the DevKit V1 build. Uses native USB-CDC over USB-C. BOOT button on GPIO 0 (factory-reset gesture). On-board user LED on GPIO 21 — blink capability is visible externally.
